canonical_example.text: Toma cinco años pagar el préstamo del carro.
canonical_example.translation: It takes five years to repay the loan on the car.

canonical_example.text: Las autoridades aconsejan permanecer adentro durante la tormenta.
canonical_example.translation: The authorities advise everyone to stay inside during the storm.

canonical_example.text: El médico le aconsejó reposo para curar su lesión de rodilla.
canonical_example.translation: The doctor recommended rest to help his knee recover.

canonical_example.text: No sé qué hacer. ¿Me puedes aconsejar?
canonical_example.translation: I don't know what to do. Can you advise me?

meanings.context: to give advice to a person

sense_provider_metadata.context: to give advice to a person

canonical_example.text: La gran afluencia de turistas aconseja restringir la entrada al parque.
canonical_example.translation: The huge tourist influx makes limiting access to the park advisable.

canonical_example.text: Deberías aconsejarte con un abogado.
canonical_example.translation: You should seek advice from a lawyer.
